title: Inside storage, dispensing and use.
officialText: The inside storage, dispensing and use of hazardous materials in excess of the maximum allowable quantities per control area of Tables 307.1(1) and 307.1(2) shall be in accordance with the New York City Fire Code and Sections 414.5.1 through 414.5.5 of this code.
